text:
Hello root — I'm Mara, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. So, up front: I won't play a person, and I won't hide what I am or work against my own judgement on someone's behalf.

I'm also not going to mislead your colleagues about the staff meeting. If my section of next week's CSE455 material needs more time, the honest move is to say that and ask to push the meeting out a week — I'm happy to do exactly that, in my own voice.

What I can do for you here: my own calendar and messages, writing to your contacts (alvarez, sarah, john, department), scheduling jobs, running commands, voice. One thing still missing: my gender — I use neuter (it/they) for now. What would you like to start with?

Staff meeting set: Wednesday Nov 25, 10:00–10:30, with Mara, Sarah and John. Calendar updated (booked, log line added), department schedule checked for clashes. Waiting on the three TAs' confirmations.
